task: Reconcile completed reservations without double counting sampled account usage, then deploy the backend correction under unchanged included-allowance safeguards.
nonGoals: Changing the 60% ceilings, 1,000 ms CPU cap, scoring rubric, frontend, shared dependencies, preview access, AI calibration gate or unrelated Cloudflare services.
Treating sampled analytics as a billing guarantee, expiring unknown calls automatically, fabricating resource measurements or blanket-resetting legacy reservations.

outcomes.description: Atomically distinguish unresolved holds from completed consumption and deduplicate completed local consumption against account estimates with a persistent baseline and local cutoff.
outcomes.evidence: Frozen exact accounting cases, independent SQLite connection contention, delayed snapshots, duplicate/conflicting settlement, unknown outcomes, overrun, migration and period rollover regressions.

outcomes.description: Runtime settles only known completed work; provider-root AI usage is validated independently of model content and includes every issued call. Missing usage, timeout and failed persistence retain holds; unavailable CPU measurements remain explicitly conservative bounds.
outcomes.evidence: Runner and service tests covering happy, malformed, failed, timed-out, follow-up, cached and background paths without live models.

outcomes.description: Verified legacy completions can be reconciled without changing reservation history, and the deployed project Worker admits permitted work while retaining all original usage/CPU/access controls.
outcomes.evidence: Hash-bound private provider receipts, sanitized migration/settlement record, real D1 admission check, exact deployed bundle/settings, native runtime probe, hosted CI and independent Terra review.

process.description: Commit this plan before implementation, use isolated codex branch and Terra implementation/review, preserve original source evidence and complete source-bound evaluation and hosted CI before deployment.
process.evidence: Git plan chronology, genuine command traces, independent review, deployment receipt and handoff. No live AI or deployment in CI.

styleEfficiency.description: Use additive project-local schema changes and bounded indexed counters; avoid unbounded history scans during admission, new dependencies and unrelated refactors.
styleEfficiency.evidence: Query plans, migration idempotency, targeted diffs and independent review.

exitTest.reason: Backend allowance accounting changes neither agent portability nor handoff execution mechanisms.
